sourceSentences: Three Talon Strike basic attack resets Xin Zhao's basic attack timer.

Xin Zhao empowers his next three basic attacks on-attack within 5 seconds to each have an uncancellable windup, deal bonus physical damage and reduce his other abilities' current cooldowns by 1 second.
The enhanced attacks present input buffering during their wind-up animation (Xin Zhao cannot be issued any commands until after it ends).
The farthest champion or large monster hit within the thrust's area is also marked as Challenged and is revealed for 3 seconds.
Xin Zhao reveals himself during the cast if there is an enemy champion nearby.
The thrust will occur from wherever Xin Zhao is at the end of the cast time.
Audacious Charge's range is increased against Challenged targets.
Three Talon Strike and Crescent Guard can be cast during the dash.
Only one enemy can be marked as Challenged at a time; applying the mark to a new target removes it from the previous one.
knocking back all targets hit that are not Challenged up-to 700 units over 0.75 seconds, as well as stunning them for the same duration.
For the next 4 seconds, Xin Zhao is invulnerable against enemy champions far away from him.

Pets, stealthed traps, ground-targeted area of effects, damage over time, and delayed-damage abilities (e.g. Death Mark, Explosive Charge, Hemoplague) will not damage Xin Zhao if the enemy champion source is outside the circle when the damage applies.
Displacement immunity will also resist the application of the stun.
3 Minute LoL : Pour les combos, commencez par E puis une attaque avant d'utiliser A pour trois attaques. Enchaînez avec Z, une attaque et l'ultime, puis attaquez tout en vous déplaçant.
3 Minute LoL : Votre combo d'engagement longue portée est Z suivi du E, puis attaquez et utilisez l'ultime.

3 Minute LoL : La portée du dash est augmentée si l'ennemi est marqué comme défié ; vous appliquez cette marque avec votre Z, puis après le niveau six, vos auto-attaques et votre E l'appliqueront aussi.
3 Minute LoL : L'ultime de Xin inflige des dégâts dans un large cercle autour de lui, repoussant tous les ennemis touchés qui n'étaient pas défiés.
3 Minute LoL : Placer votre Z sur une cible prioritaire, sauter dessus et utiliser votre ultime crée un chaos total tout en vous protégeant des autres ennemis.
